description: read a registered plan-template card's curation view: its current lifecycle state and the discovery-by-intent axes (goal, domain, outcome) that make it findable and forkable.
embedding_description: Look up a plan template by its key and read its curation view — the current lifecycle state (draft, active, superseded, or archived), the human-facing title, the replacement key when superseded, and the discovery-by-intent axes goal/domain/outcome. This reads the front-matter curation metadata, not the joseki-program skeleton body. Returns found=false when no card exists for the key.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Curation view with keys: found, template_key, title, state, goal, domain, outcome, superseded_by
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the template_key with its current state and, for a superseded template, the superseded_by replacement. Summarize the goal/domain/outcome discovery axes so the caller can judge whether this is the skeleton to fork. When found is false, say the template is not registered.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the state to decide next steps: an active (or draft) template is forkable by intent; a superseded template points at its replacement via superseded_by; an archived template is retired. This is an observability read — it does not change the template.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading a plan template's curation view by template_key. get_plan_template accepts {template_key} and never mutates the card.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: PlanTemplateStateConflict: a card exists at the key's path but its Template Key disagrees with the requested key (a mismatched/drifted card). PlanTemplateCardError (core): the stored card is malformed (missing a required field or an unknown state) and cannot be parsed. A missing card is NOT an error — it returns found=false.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Mismatched card: operate on the key the card actually declares, or repair the card's Template Key line. Malformed card: fix the missing/invalid front-matter field named in the message. Absent template: confirm the key, or register the template before reading it.
